records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarter ended March 30, 2024, 36% of revenue was recognized at the point in time control transferred to the customer.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Twelve-month backlog increased in the second quarter of 2024 compared with the second quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Partially offsetting these increases was a decline in Industrial's twelve-month backlog due to lower orders across our industrial automation and our medical device programs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin increased in the second quarter of 2024 compared to the second quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased across all of our segments in the second quarter and in the first half of 2024 compared to the second quarter and the first half of 2023.
